newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal public sector union calls Dec 5 strike.
newsitem.headline: Portugal public sector union calls Dec 5 strike.

text.p: Portugal's main public sector trade union group said it would stage a protest march on December 5 against the Socialist government's proposal to raise wages by 2.6 percent in 1997.

"(This proposal) increases the gap with private sector and European salaries and aggravates the scandalous difference between public sector and national minimum wages," the 300,000-strong Frente Comum said in a statement.
The government's inflation target for 1997 is between 2.25 and 2.50 percent.
Frente Comum represents about half of Portugal's estimated 500,000 to 800,000 civil servants.
